location_exception_reason: Metal sheds are prefabricated industrial/warehouse structures sold nationwide with standardised specifications (MS frame, GI/Galvalume roofing, clear-span width, eave height). Location of manufacture or seller is not a buyer decision factor; structural compliance (IS 2062, IS 15917) and performance specs are. Location names in titles add no product information.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer', 'Exporter') are redundant in metal shed titles. IndiaMART already exposes seller business type as a buyer-facing filter independent of product titles. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Metal Shed Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning unchanged; the product is a metal shed regardless of who sells it.
